dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the trailing edge forming a distinct falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius at the maximum vertical elevation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply inclined convex leading edge relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width exceeds maximum vertical height by approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc characteristic of a defined melon region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostral projection with high pixel thickness relative to visible length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point where the melon curvature meets the rostrum ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The subject is rendered with a uniform monochromatic cyan/teal color map across the entire visible surface.
